# hpe_morpheus_network_router_route (Data Source)



## Example Usage - Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_route" "example" {
  name      = "default"
  router_id = 5
}
```

## Example Usage - Id

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_route" "example" {
  id        = 1
  router_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Router ID

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the Network router route.
- `name` (String) The name of the Network router route.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String)
- `default_route` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `external_id` (String)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `route_type` (String)
